_comment: Hand-curated rentable lookouts that are NOT on Recreation.gov. Source: docs/fire-lookout-research.md, booking links from the FFLA rentals page (firelookout.org/resources/rentals), coordinates from FFLA state lookout lists unless marked approximate. Re-check every winter.

lookouts.name: Quartz Mountain Lookout
lookouts.season_notes: Season roughly June 15 to Oct 1. Two-night minimum. 2.7-mile hike or bike from Selkirk Lodge. Sleeps 4. Call center (888) 226-7688.

release_rule.note: Reservable up to nine months before arrival on GoingToCamp.

lookouts.name: North Mountain Lookout
lookouts.season_notes: Nonprofit-run. Bookings are managed by the host.

release_rule.note: Host-managed calendar on Airbnb. Check the listing for open dates.

lookouts.name: Lorena Butte Relocated Lookout
lookouts.season_notes: Relocated lookout on a working ranch.

lookouts.name: Thorny Mountain Fire Tower
lookouts.season_notes: May to October. Sells out at release. Cancellations are reportedly not released online. Forest office 304-799-6213.

release_rule.note: Each month opens online at 12:00 a.m. Eastern on the 1st, one year ahead.

lookouts.name: Werner Peak Lookout
lookouts.season_notes: Rentable July 6 to 31 and Sept 1 to 30 (staffed in August). Max 2 nights per guest per season. Phone only: 406-881-2371, no voicemail or email requests.

release_rule.note: One phone day a year, recently the first Tuesday of February, 8:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. Mountain. Re-check with DNRC each January.

lookouts.name: Moon Pass Replica Lookout (Half Moon)
lookouts.season_notes: Replica, not a historic lookout. Map pin is approximate.

lookouts.name: Moon Pass Replica Lookout (Full Moon)
lookouts.season_notes: Replica, not a historic lookout. Map pin is approximate.

lookouts.name: Gordon Fire Tower Cabin
lookouts.season_notes: Guests stay in a ground cabin with exclusive access to the 100-ft tower. Booking June through October.

release_rule.note: Host-managed. Typically books June through October.
